Professional Galaxy är ett IT- och teknikkonsultbolag som tillhandahåller högspecialiserad kompetens inom IT, mjukvaruutveckling, SAP, inköp, elektronik och mekanisk konstruktion. Vi samarbetar med erfarna seniora experter och levererar strategiskt värdeskapande kompetens till några av Sveriges mest komplexa och analytiskt krävande projekt. Vårt fokus ligger alltid på hög kvalitet, professionalism och tydliga, mätbara resultat.

Vi söker nu en Data & AI Platform Engineer – Technical Lead hos vår kund.

Om uppdraget De söker en Technical Team Lead till vårt team inom Software Excellence och Information Assurance (SWEIXA). I denna seniora roll leder du teamet och ansvarar för design, implementation, installation, konfiguration och support av molnnativa Data & AI-plattformar.

Du blir en nyckelperson och teknisk ledare i arbetet med att designa, implementera och leverera AI-lösningar. Rollen innebär även att bidra med djup kunskap om AI-verktyg – deras möjligheter och begränsningar – samt att delta i dialoger med kunder för att förstå och omsätta tekniska behov till fungerande lösningar.

Vår kund söker dig som är kreativ, lösningsorienterad och kommunikativ, med en stark teknisk grund inom Kubernetes, automation och hantering av stora datavolymer. Du fungerar även som mentor och tekniskt stöd till teamet inom molnnativa lösningar och modern molnarkitektur.

Huvudsakliga ansvarsområden Ansvara för end-to-end-arkitektur, systemdesign och teknisk implementation av plattformen. Ta fram use case och delta i utvecklingen av kompletta AI-system. Förstå kundens verksamhetsbehov och översätta dessa till tekniska arkitekturlösningar. Leda implementation och driftsättning, inklusive installation, konfiguration och felsökning. Tillhandahålla och delegera teknisk support inom Data & AI-relaterade områden. Hålla dig uppdaterad kring den senaste utvecklingen inom AI och bidra strategiskt till produktens roadmap. Genomföra regelbundna genomgångar och optimeringar av Data & AI-miljöer. Ta fram riktlinjer för hantering av AI-miljöer. Coacha och utveckla juniora medarbetare samt bidra med tekniskt ledarskap. Krav Gedigen erfarenhet av Golang och andra systemnära programmeringsspråk, inklusive utveckling av Kubernetes-operatorer. Högskole- eller civilingenjörsexamen inom exempelvis data engineering eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet. Praktisk erfarenhet av molnarkitektur, högpresterande applikationer (molnnativa och traditionella), samt hur DevSecOps best practices tillämpas. Möjligheten 
Energi är grunden för ett fungerande samhälle – och framtidens energisystem kräver säkra, tillförlitliga och väl fungerande nätverk. Vill du arbeta med nätverkslösningar i några av världens mest avancerade kraftsystem?
 Hitachi Energy levererar elnätsteknologi som försörjer över tre miljarder människor världen över. Nu söker vi en Nätverkstekniker till vårt HVDC-team i Ludvika.
Som nätverkstekniker arbetar du med design, konfiguration och felsökning av nätverkslösningar i våra HVDC-anläggningar och testsystem. Du blir en viktig del i leveransen av säkra och stabila kommunikationslösningar för styr- och övervakningssystem i kritisk infrastruktur.
Du arbetar nära ingenjörsteamet, site och projektorganisationen och säkerställer att nätverkslösningarna fungerar både i labbmiljö och i verklig drift.
Hur du kommer att påverka 
Konfiguration och underhåll av nätverksutrustning (främst Cisco och Fortinet)
Design och implementering av nätverkslösningar för industriella system
Felsökning av nätverksproblem i labb, verkstad och site-miljö
Medverka vid tester, verifiering och driftsättning
Dokumentation av nätverksdesign och konfigurationer
Samverkan med automation, IT-säkerhet och systemingenjörer

Din bakgrund 
Erfarenhet av nätverksteknik, gärna inom industriella eller kritiska system
Praktisk erfarenhet av Cisco- och/eller Fortinet-miljöer
God förståelse för TCP/IP, VLAN, routing och brandväggar
Förmåga att arbeta strukturerat i tekniska miljöer
God kommunikationsförmåga på svenska eller engelska
Eftersom rollen innebär nära samarbete med globala projektteam kommer personliga egenskaper att vara viktiga i rekryteringen

Vad vi erbjuder 
Kollektivavtal 
Flexibla arbetstider 
Företagshälsovård och friskvårdsbidrag 
Fantastiska karriärmöjligheter inom Hitachi Energy i Sverige såväl som globalt 
Kompletterande bidrag vid föräldraledighet 
Förmånsportal med över tusen förmåner och rabatter
Utbildningar och kurser som bidrar till personlig och professionell utveckling 
Diversifierat företag med över 70+ nationaliteter representerade inom den svenska organisationen

Mer om oss 
Är du redo för en ny utmaning? Välkommen med din ansökan! Ansökningar granskas löpande, så ansök idag! 
Rekryterande chef Perilla Kilström, pernilla.kilstrom@hitachienergy.com  svarar på dina frågor om tjänsten. Fackliga representanter – Sveriges Ingenjörer: Mikael Hjort, +46 107-38 29 86; Ledarna: Frank Hollstedt, +46 107-38 70 43; Unionen: Fredrik Holmgren, +46 107-38 21 85. Alla andra frågor kan riktas till Talent Partner Fredrik Söder, fredrik.soder@hitachienergy.com
English version
The Opportunity
Energy is the foundation of a functioning society—and the energy systems of the future demand secure, reliable, and well‑performing networks. Interested in working with networking solutions for some of the most advanced power systems in the world?
Hitachi Energy delivers grid technology that supplies electricity to over three billion people globally. We are now looking for a Network Engineer to join our HVDC team in Ludvika.
In this role, you will work with the design, configuration, and troubleshooting of network solutions in our HVDC installations and test environments. You will play an essential part in delivering secure and stable communication solutions for control and monitoring systems within critical infrastructure.
You will collaborate closely with engineering teams, site personnel, and project organizations to ensure that network solutions function both in laboratory environments and in real operation.
How You Will Make an Impact
Configuration and maintenance of network equipment (primarily Cisco and Fortinet)
Design and implementation of network solutions for industrial systems
Troubleshooting network issues in lab, workshop, and site environments
Participation in testing, verification, and commissioning activities
Documentation of network design and configurations
Collaboration with automation, cybersecurity, and system engineering teams

Your Background
Experience in network engineering, preferably within industrial or critical systems
Hands‑on experience with Cisco and/or Fortinet environments
Strong understanding of TCP/IP, VLAN, routing, and firewalls
Ability to work in a structured and technical environment
Good communication skills in Swedish or English
Since the role involves close collaboration with global project teams, personal qualities will play an important part in the selection process

What We Offer
Collective agreements
Flexible working hours
Occupational health services and wellness contribution
Excellent career opportunities within Hitachi Energy in Sweden and internationally
Training and courses that support personal and professional development
A diverse organization with more than 70 nationalities represented within the Swedish organization
Additional parental leave compensation
A benefits portal with more than a thousand discounts and perks

More About Us
Ready for a new challenge? You are welcome to submit your application. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so apply today. Hiring Manager: Perilla Kilström, pernilla.kilstrom@hitachienergy.com can answer questions about the position. Union representatives – Sveriges Ingenjörer: Mikael Hjort, +46 107-38 29 86; Ledarna: Frank Hollstedt, +46 107-38 70 43; Unionen: Fredrik Holmgren, +46 107-38 21 85. For all other questions, contact Talent Partner Fredrik Söder at fredrik.soder@hitachienergy.com

description.text:
At Lyten, we believe the most meaningful careers begin with purpose — and with people who want to make a difference. We’re not just developing advanced supermaterials — we’re about to change the world as we know it, reshaping how energy is stored, how products are built, and how progress is made.
We’re entering an exciting growth phase, scaling production across the U.S. and Europe and expanding our team of engineers, scientists, and innovators.
Apply now to join our team and be part of something bigger than yourself — where collaboration, creativity, and purpose come together to build the technologies that will define the next century.
Key Responsibilities
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities
Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to)
Business Partnering: Support joint IT/business roadmap planning and prioritization, ensuring business needs, process requirements, and improvement opportunities are clearly captured and cost-justified. Develop a comprehensive business systems roadmap for enhancements, upgrades, and cross-functional improvements. Participate in designing and delivering business system solutions that strengthen operational performance while optimizing costs. Monitor process and tool performance and recommend data-driven improvements that increase business value and reduce total cost of ownership.
Operational Leadership: Lead and guide internal and external contributors involved in business systems delivery, including operations, maintenance, and continuous improvements. Coordinate with relevant subject matter experts to align solution design with business requirements while managing costs and resource allocation efficiently. Maintain documentation of processes, systems, and target capabilities. Proactively ensure all operational business systems deliver intended value and support structured prioritization of initiatives. Tactically perform system configurations, troubleshooting, and issue resolution to maintain operational continuity.
Strategic Architecture & Governance: Ensure alignment between business needs, system developments, and the company's Business, Digital & IT Strategy. Lead and drive changes to the business systems architecture to support evolving business requirements and cost optimization. Maintain effective governance routines with clear principles, standards, and decision-making structures for business systems. Monitor industry trends and system roadmaps to inform future direction and strategic planning. Participate in the Change Advisory Board for changes impacting the business systems landscape, ensuring architectural integrity and cost-effectiveness.
Technical Leadership & Collaboration: Provide leadership in clarifying requirements, shaping solution direction, and supporting delivery execution with hands-on technical involvement when needed. Lead cross-functional collaboration to achieve agreed system and process outcomes and guide stakeholders towards best practices. Translate business-driven needs into actionable work packages and support teams during implementation. Actively participate in business-driven projects with system dependencies, including tactical configuration work and operational problem-solving.
Integration & Standards: Ensure that business system integrations follow established standards and effective architectural and process conventions. Identify and challenge unnecessary customization and promote harmonization across the systems landscape to reduce costs and complexity. Support the definition of integration guidelines, naming conventions, and data flow clarity. Drive consistency, reusability, and alignment across all business systems. Take responsibility for architectural changes that improve system efficiency, reduce technical debt, and optimize operational costs.
Cost Optimization & Value Management: Monitor and optimize business systems costs including licensing, infrastructure, and operational expenses. Identify opportunities for cost reduction through system consolidation, automation, and process improvements. Ensure all business system investments and changes deliver measurable ROI and align with budget constraints. Balance cost efficiency with system performance and business value delivery.
Hands-On Technical Execution: Despite the senior nature of the role, tactically and operationally perform system configurations, customizations, and optimizations as needed. Directly troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues to maintain system availability and performance. Provide hands-on support during critical implementations, upgrades, and incidents to ensure business continuity.

Accountability/Authorization
Budget responsibility: No
Direct reports: No

Requirements
Educational background and previous experience required for the role.
8+ years of experience in business systems, program management, digital transformation, or enterprise process improvement.
Experience leading cross-functional programs and delivering complex system initiatives in fast-paced environments.
Experience working with enterprise business systems (ERP, HRIS, PLM, MES, Finance, Supply Chain systems or similar).
Strong experience with stakeholder management, requirements definition, and structured prioritization.
Experience working in rapid-growth, change-heavy environments with diverse stakeholder landscapes.

Specific skills
Strong program and project management capabilities with the ability to structure, steer and deliver system initiatives.
Ability to translate business needs into system requirements and guide delivery teams toward effective solutions.
Understanding enterprise system architecture principles and integration patterns.
Working knowledge of ITSM processes including incident, problem, and change management.
Strong business acumen with the ability to engage stakeholders on system strategy and value contribution.
Excellent communication and facilitation skills.

Personal success factors
Strategic, structured, and analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills.
Demonstrated leadership across diverse technical and business stakeholders.
Ability to build trust and influence without formal authority.
Proactive, adaptable, and capable of navigating ambiguity while maintaining clarity for others.
Strong communicator able to articulate complex topics in simple and actionable terms.
